title: Save the Bees!
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 13. Human VOA audio; WorldVoice provides only a selected, bilingual transcript excerpt; read the full conversation on the credited official page. No sentence timings have been verified. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.text: I have a feeling that your fear of bees will be gone soon. There are things beekeepers do to protect ourselves. For example, we wear protective clothing. This is a beekeeper’s veil, suit and gloves. There are other things we can do, too. If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm.
dialogue.translation_ar: أظن أن خوفك من النحل سيزول قريبًا. يفعل مربّو النحل أشياء لحماية أنفسهم، مثل ارتداء ملابس واقية وقناع وقفازات. وإذا استخدمت أداة التدخين فسيهدأ النحل.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Let’s use smoke … lots of smoke.

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.text: Okay, Anna, that’s enough smoke. Another thing you can do is stay calm. Okay. When I lift the frame, you will see the bees.
dialogue.translation_ar: حسنًا يا آنا، هذا دخان كافٍ. يمكنك أيضًا الحفاظ على هدوئك. عندما أرفع الإطار سترين النحل.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I’m ready. Let's do this thing!

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.text: Okay, let's put on our protective clothing.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: There are so many! And they are so busy! Now I know why we say, “busy as a bee!”
dialogue.translation_ar: ما أكثرها! وكم هي مشغولة! الآن فهمت لماذا نقول «مشغول كالنحلة»!
